name: BITEZ Gummies 10,000MG Jarz - Delta-8 + Delta-9 + THCP - Rainbow Sherbet
description: Rainbow Sherbet TRIPLE-Stacked BITEZ bring three vibrant layers together for our most layered gummy yet. Tangy raspberry, zesty orange, and fresh lime stack up to recreate that nostalgic rainbow sherbet flavor with a sweet, citrusy finish. Each triple-stacked gummy packs a powerful 1,000mg Delta-8, Delta-9, and THCP blend (10 gummies per jar, 10,000mg total). This limited release won’t be around forever, so stock up before it’s gone!
